root_idea.summary: A downward-reaching depth or bottom: the lowest or innermost extremity of a thing.
root_idea.development: The basic depth-and-bottom notion extends to reaching or making a bottom, deep wells and vessels, figurative profundity, speech from the depth of the throat, and removal from a root or descent into the earth.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized active-participle citation form مُنْقَعِرٌ.

senses.definition: Uprooted, extirpated, and fallen prostrate, as though driven down into the earth and leaving no trace.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic simile for the lower parts of palm trees, the form is explained either as uprooted from its root or as gone into the depth of the earth; both interpretations express complete removal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be deep, especially to have a deep bottom, as a well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive usage describing the depth of a well or similar thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reach the bottom of a well by descending to it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of descending through a well until its lowest point is reached.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a well deep.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Transitive usage describing the deepening of a well.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To drink a vessel or eat a dish down to its bottom.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional extended usage for consuming all the contents to the lowest part of the vessel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pull a tree from its root or cut down a palm tree from its root.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive usage describing removal from the root.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To throw someone down prostrate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An explicitly marked extended usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To speak from the furthest part of the mouth or throat, producing a guttural delivery.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II speech expression concerning the place and manner of articulation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a bottom for a well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV causative usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go deep.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form V usage describing movement or penetration toward depth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become prostrate and overturned.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An explicitly marked extended usage, applied to a person or thing that has fallen over.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To die; in one idiom, to die leaving one's property behind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended Form VII usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The bottom, lowest depth, or remotest interior of a thing; the depth of a well, river, or vessel, including the root or lowest part of a palm or similar thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The core noun of physical depth and lowest extremity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The innermost part of a house; figuratively, keeping within one's house or being an intimate in it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression based on the innermost part of a house.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Figurative depth of judgment, examination, or speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of profound judgment or language that has, or lacks, depth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hollow or depression in the ground whose descent and ascent are difficult.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographic or terrain term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A city or town.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately attested lexical use, especially in expressions referring to the people of a city.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bowl or large serving dish.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantival vessel use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Full, perfect, or profound intellect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative noun distinct from the physical bottom sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: What covers the bottom of a bowl.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A vessel-related noun describing material or contents at the bottom.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A deep drinking cup or bowl.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived vessel term equivalent in sense to a deepened or concave vessel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A vessel nearly full or containing something that covers its bottom.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An explicitly marked extended vessel usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Deep or having a remote bottom, said of a well or bowl.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a deep well or vessel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A specialized epithet for a woman's vulva; one report extends the term to a woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare anatomical and personal usage reported in the lexical tradition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Deeper.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Comparative adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who reaches the bottoms or utmost points of things or affairs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied figuratively to someone thorough or penetrating in dealing with matters.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wide and deep, said of a cup.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a cup or similar vessel.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Reaching the bottom and deepening a well represented separately.
Consuming vessel contents to the bottom represented.
Uprooting and throwing down prostrate represented.
Making a bottom for a well represented.
Pointer-only cross-reference to the vessel usage.
Uprooting, prostration, and descent into earth are covered by the Quranic participial sense.
Physical bottom/depth and the house expression represented.
Physical depth and figurative depth represented.
Root or lowest part of a palm is included in the broader bottom/depth meaning.
Material covering the bottom of a bowl represented.
Deep cup or bowl meaning represented.
Nearly full or bottom-covered vessel meaning represented.
Deep-vessel adjective and specialized anatomical usage represented.
Figurative person who reaches utmost points represented.

cautions: The Quranic lexical explanation preserves two closely related reported interpretations: uprooted from the root and gone into the depth of the earth; they are presented as one removal-to-depth sense.
The public headword is normalized to the singular active participle مُنْقَعِرٌ, while QAC records the Quran occurrence as an inflected nominal form.
